author: LadyLeigh
name: Store
short: Buy Crates rewards with your existing economy balance.
description: An independent embed shop with categories, purchase confirmation, limited stock, Red bank payments, and compatible Crates item and extra-opening rewards. Starts with an empty catalog.
install_msg: Load the updated Crates cog, configure listings with [p]storeset, and browse with [p]store. Store uses Red's standard bank balance and currency name.
end_user_data_statement: Stores per-server listings, settings, and purchase records containing member IDs, prices, status, timestamps, and delivered reward details. Supports Red user data deletion requests. Crates stores inventory and purchase delivery receipts separately.
